aka.en: Kong Sham Western Highway and Shenzhen Bay Bridge (Hong Kong–Shenzhen Western Corridor)
aka.zh: 港深西部公路及深圳湾公路大桥（深港西部通道）

tagline.en: The only trunk route that ends at a border, and the only one partly built outside Hong Kong
tagline.zh: 唯一止于边境、也唯一有部分建在香港境外的干线

start.en: The Yuen Long Highway (Route 9) at Lam Tei, Tuen Mun
start.zh: 屯门蓝地，与元朗公路（9号干线）相接

end.en: The Hong Kong port area of Shenzhen Bay Port at Dongjiaotou, Shekou — on Shenzhen land but under Hong Kong law — continuing by the Dongbin Tunnel to the Guangzhou–Shenzhen Riverside Expressway
end.zh: 蛇口东角头深圳湾口岸港方口岸区——位于深圳土地、但适用香港法律——经东滨隧道连接广深沿江高速公路

en: Route 10 is 10.9 km of dual three-lane expressway from Lam Tei, on the edge of Tuen Mun, to the Shenzhen Bay Port at Shekou. It is two roads: the 5.4 km Kong Sham Western Highway, built as the Deep Bay Link, which runs north past Ha Tsuen to the shore at Ngau Hom Shek, and the 5.5 km Shenzhen Bay Bridge across Deep Bay. It is the whole of the Hong Kong–Shenzhen Western Corridor, and all of it is part of Asian Highway 1, though that is not signed in Hong Kong.

Among Hong Kong's trunk routes it is the only one that ends at a border crossing, the only one partly built outside Hong Kong, and the only one that is expressway from end to end. North of the Ha Tsuen interchange it is a closed road: drivers without a closed-road permit, other than urban and New Territories taxis, must leave at exit 1. A sign at the port end, lettered in mainland-style characters, marks the end of the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao expressway.
zh: 10号干线由屯门边缘的蓝地至蛇口深圳湾口岸，全长 10.9 公里，为三线双程快速公路。它由两段组成：工程名称为后海湾干线、长 5.4 公里的港深西部公路，向北经厦村通至鳌磡石海岸；以及横跨后海湾、长 5.5 公里的深圳湾公路大桥。它就是整个深港西部通道，全线亦属亚洲公路 1 号线，但香港并无标示。
在香港各条干线之中，它是唯一止于边境口岸的，唯一有部分建在香港境外的，也是唯一全线均为快速公路的。厦村交汇处以北为封闭道路：除市区及新界的士外，没有封闭道路通行许可证的车辆必须在 1 号出口离开。口岸一端立有一块以新字形书写的“粤港澳高速公路终点”路牌。

en: The Shenzhen Bay Bridge is 5,545 m long: about 3,505 m on the Hong Kong side and 2,040 m on the Shenzhen side. Each side has a single-tower, single-plane cable-stayed span on a steel box girder, with towers leaning slightly towards each other, and the whole bridge stands on 457 piles. Its plan is an S, to reduce its effect on the flow of water in Deep Bay and to keep drivers alert. Its design speed is 100 km/h, the highest of any bridge in Hong Kong, and it closes partly when the mean wind exceeds 55 km/h and completely above 65 km/h.

The bridge was built on the principle that each side would invest in, build, own and manage its own half, divided at the Guangdong–Hong Kong boundary, to a single standard and timetable. Hong Kong maintains the deck of the Shenzhen half; Shenzhen maintains that half's piers. The Kong Sham Western Highway's deck, 108,000 m² in 3,014 segments, was built in a northern section by Gammon Skanska and a southern one by a China State Construction joint venture.

In February 2019 a routine inspection found one of the six external prestressing tendons broken on the Hong Kong viaduct near Ngau Hom Shek. The Highways Department's investigation traced it to faulty grouting during construction, which left a void where the tendon corroded; the bridge was designed to tolerate two broken tendons, and the tendon was replaced within a month.
zh: 深圳湾公路大桥全长 5,545 米：香港段约 3,505 米，深圳段约 2,040 米。两段各有一座单塔单索面钢箱梁斜拉桥，桥塔微微倾斜、互相仰向对方，全桥共有 457 支桩柱。大桥呈 S 形走线，以减轻对后海湾水流的影响，并提高司机的警觉。设计时速 100 公里，是香港境内车速限制最高的桥；平均风速超过每小时 55 公里时局部封闭，超过 65 公里时全面封闭。
大桥按“以粤港分界线为界，各自投资、共同建设、各自拥有、各自管理”的原则兴建，两地采用统一的建设标准和工期。深圳段桥面由香港负责维修，深圳段桥墩则由深圳方面维护。港深西部公路桥面面积 108,000 平方米，由 3,014 件节段组成；北段由金门建筑（时称 Gammon Skanska）承建，南段由中国建筑联营体承建。
2019 年 2 月，路政署例行检查时发现，鳌磡石附近香港段高架桥六条外置预应力钢缆中有一条折断。路政署的调查报告指，原因是施工时灌浆出错，留下空腔，令钢缆锈蚀；大桥设计可承受两条钢缆断裂，折断的钢缆在一个月内更换完毕。

en: Route 10 was first planned as something much larger. In the late 1990s it was to run from Kennedy Town on Hong Kong Island through a proposed Green Island reclamation, by tunnel to Kau Yi Chau and a new port off Lantau, over a bridge across the Ma Wan channel to Tsing Lung Tau, and through Tai Lam and Lam Tei to the Yuen Long Highway, meeting a Deep Bay Link to Shenzhen. In 1997–98 the government asked the Provisional Legislative Council for HK$353.8 million to investigate and design the North Lantau–Yuen Long section, and in November 1999 for HK$454.5 million for detailed design.

It was not built. The So Kwun Wat–North Lantau section was gazetted on 28 June 2002 after more than 500 objections, but slower traffic growth, opposition from the operator of the Tai Lam Tunnel and a lack of support in the Legislative Council put it off; the Hong Kong Island end lapsed with the Green Island reclamation, and the planned Container Terminal 10 site went to Disneyland.

What was built was the cross-border piece. A 2001 study found the three road crossings to Shenzhen, at Lok Ma Chau, Man Kam To and Sha Tau Kok, would be full by about 2006. The Shenzhen Bay Bridge was begun on 28 August 2003 and the two halves were joined on 20 January 2006; the Deep Bay Link was built from June 2003. Both opened on 1 July 2007, the tenth anniversary of the handover, the highway having been named Kong Sham Western Highway on 22 June.

The western extension has since been rethought. The Tuen Mun–Chek Lap Kok Link, announced in 2007 to take the place of the old Yuen Long–Lantau alignment, opened on 27 December 2020 and is planned to become part of Route 10. The Tuen Mun Western Bypass that was to join it to Lam Tei was moved east and renamed the Tuen Mun Bypass at the end of 2020, reported for completion before 2036. The Lantau–Hong Kong Island idea now belongs to the planned Route 11.
zh: 10号干线最初的规划要大得多。1990 年代末，它计划由港岛坚尼地城起，经拟议中的青洲填海区，以隧道通往交椅洲及大屿山对开的新港口，再以大桥跨越马湾海峡至青龙头，然后经大榄、蓝地接上元朗公路，并与通往深圳的后海湾连接路相接。1997 至 1998 年，政府向临时立法会申请 3 亿 5,380 万港元，为北大屿山至元朗公路进行勘察及初步设计；1999 年 11 月再申请 4 亿 5,450 万港元进行详细设计。
这条路最终没有建成。扫管笏至北大屿山段在收到 500 多份反对书后，于 2002 年 6 月 28 日刊宪；但由于交通需求增长放缓、大榄隧道营运者反对，加上未获立法会议员支持，计划被押后。港岛一端随青洲填海计划搁置而落空，原定兴建10号货柜码头的用地亦改建为迪士尼乐园。
真正建成的是过境一段。2001 年的研究指出，落马洲、文锦渡和沙头角三个陆路口岸约在 2006 年便会饱和。深圳湾公路大桥于 2003 年 8 月 28 日动工，两段桥身于 2006 年 1 月 20 日合拢；后海湾干线则自 2003 年 6 月动工。两者于 2007 年 7 月 1 日——香港回归十周年当日——一并通车，公路已于 6 月 22 日命名为港深西部公路。
西面的延伸其后改变了方案。2007 年宣布兴建、用以取代旧元朗至大屿山走线的屯门至赤鱲角连接路，已于 2020 年 12 月 27 日通车，计划日后纳入10号干线。原本把它接到蓝地的屯门西绕道，于 2020 年底改行屯门东并易名为屯门绕道，据报预计 2036 年前完工。至于大屿山至港岛的构想，现已归入规划中的11号干线。

en: Each government paid for its own side. The Hong Kong government funded the Kong Sham Western Highway and the Hong Kong half of the bridge from its public works programme; Shenzhen paid for the half within its boundary. Neither is a franchise, and the route is toll-free.
zh: 两地政府各自支付本方一侧的费用。香港政府以工务计划拨款兴建港深西部公路及大桥香港段；深圳则负责其境内的一半。两者均非专营权项目，全线免费。

en: The bridge is limited to 100 km/h and the Kong Sham Western Highway to 80 or 100 km/h, with 50 km/h in the Hong Kong port area. There is a fixed speed camera northbound near the Ha Tsuen exit. When it opened, Shekou to the Tsing Long Highway or Tuen Mun Road took about 15 minutes, and Tin Shui Wai to Nanshan 10 to 15.
zh: 大桥限速每小时 100 公里，港深西部公路限速 80 或 100 公里，港方口岸区内为 50 公里。往深圳湾方向近厦村出口设有固定快相机。通车时，由蛇口经大桥及元朗公路到青朗公路或屯门公路约需 15 分钟，天水围往返深圳南山约 10 至 15 分钟。

why.en: No combined figure for the route has been published, and the two sides were funded separately. Hong Kong's sourced figures are given below; no figure was found for the Shenzhen half of the bridge.
why.zh: 全线没有公布合计造价，两地亦分别出资。香港方面有来源的数字列于下方；未找到大桥深圳段的造价。

label.zh: 后海湾干线（港深西部公路）

value.en: HK$4,600 million, approved project cost. Chinese Wikipedia gives HK$3.9 billion without a source; the difference is not explained.
value.zh: 核准工程费 46 亿港元。中文维基百科作 39 亿港元，未注来源，两者差异未见解释。

figures.source: Highways Department, Deep Bay Link (project page, 30 June 2011), as cited in English Wikipedia, Kong Sham Western Highway

value.en: HK$902 million is given as the total cost, without a source and without saying which side it covers; a 2004 Apple Daily headline put the corridor at 2.2 billion, currency not stated in the citation. Both are weak and unchecked.
value.zh: 列有总造价 9.02 亿港元，但未注来源，也未说明涵盖哪一方；2004 年《苹果日报》标题称整条通道“耗资 22 亿”，引文未注明币种。两项数字均属弱来源，未经核对。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 深圳湾公路大桥 (infobox; and Apple Daily, 12 June 2004, as cited there)

value.en: Split at the boundary: the Hong Kong SAR government for the highway and the Hong Kong half of the bridge, Shenzhen for its half — “each investing, building, owning and managing its own side”. Toll-free.
value.zh: 以边界划分：港深西部公路及大桥香港段由香港特区政府出资，深圳段由深圳出资——“各自投资、共同建设、各自拥有、各自管理”。全线免费。

figures.source: Shenzhen Commercial Daily, 3 August 2006, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 深圳湾公路大桥

value.zh: 10.9 公里：港深西部公路 5.4 公里，深圳湾公路大桥 5.5 公里

figures.source: English and Chinese Wikipedia, Route 10 (Hong Kong), Kong Sham Western Highway, 深圳湾公路大桥

timeline.en: Funding is sought for investigation of the North Lantau–Yuen Long section of a Route 10 running to Hong Kong Island.
timeline.zh: 政府为一条通往港岛的10号干线申请拨款，勘察北大屿山至元朗段。

timeline.en: The So Kwun Wat–North Lantau section is gazetted on 28 June, then deferred.
timeline.zh: 6 月 28 日，扫管笏至北大屿山段刊宪，其后押后。

timeline.en: Work starts on the Deep Bay Link in June and the Shenzhen Bay Bridge on 28 August.
timeline.zh: 6 月后海湾干线动工，8 月 28 日深圳湾公路大桥动工。

timeline.en: The Hong Kong and Shenzhen halves of the bridge are joined on 20 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 20 日，大桥香港段与深圳段合拢。

timeline.en: The Kong Sham Western Highway and Shenzhen Bay Bridge open on 1 July, the tenth anniversary of the handover.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日香港回归十周年，港深西部公路及深圳湾公路大桥通车。

timeline.en: A broken prestressing tendon is found on the Hong Kong viaduct in February and replaced.
timeline.zh: 2 月，香港段高架桥发现一条预应力钢缆折断，其后更换。

timeline.en: The Tuen Mun–Chek Lap Kok Link, planned as Route 10's extension, opens on 27 December; the Tuen Mun Western Bypass is redrawn as the Tuen Mun Bypass.
timeline.zh: 12 月 27 日，计划纳入10号干线的屯门至赤鱲角连接路通车；屯门西绕道改为屯门绕道方案。
